landmarks.name: The Arch
landmarks.note: Black iron arch gateway on brick pillars across College Ave at Broad St. Overlay sprite; player start is just north.

landmarks.name: 40 Watt Club
landmarks.note: Low brick music club, Washington St at Pulaski. Fronts the Washington St corridor.

landmarks.name: Georgia Theatre

landmarks.name: Sideways

landmarks.name: Buddha Bar

landmarks.name: Bourbon Street
